question: How far can equal-process reliability and planned-exposure-weighted reliability diverge when planned process size is informative?

negative_size_reliability_association.mismatch_curve: reversed version of the same bounded curve

synthetic_lognormal_size_stress.interpretation: The sign of the estimand gap reverses with the direction of size-outcome association. There is no generally conservative choice between equal-process and exposure weighting; they answer different questions.

outcome_dependent_realized_size_countere.policy: Use the first analytic two-type population, but stop each process at the first mismatch or its planned cap and then weight by realized completed request count.
outcome_dependent_realized_size_countere.lesson: Replacing predictable planned size by outcome-dependent realized size changes the estimand and can move the estimate materially even when every observed request is scored correctly.

recommended_joint_monitor.equal_process_channel: One bounded role/process score per pre-admitted process with unit weight. Answers reliability of an average process/run.
recommended_joint_monitor.planned_exposure_channel: The same block/process score with predictable planned-size weight B_t/B_cap fixed before current outcomes. Answers reliability of a randomly selected planned exposure under the declared process mix.
recommended_joint_monitor.completion_channel: Track completion/interruption separately or use the fail-closed composite score. Do not turn final realized completed count into a post-outcome weight.
recommended_joint_monitor.simultaneous_inference: Running two 95% confidence sequences gives marginal 95% validity for each channel, not automatically 95% joint simultaneous coverage. If a decision requires both claims simultaneously, preallocate a joint error budget or use a separately proved multivariate/e-value construction.

public_alignment: Kahan et al. 2023 show that cluster-average and participant-average estimands differ through weighting and can diverge under informative cluster size.
The 2026 CRT-Estimands extension of ICH E9(R1) continues to treat weighting/aggregation choice as part of the scientific estimand rather than an efficiency-only implementation detail.
scope_guards: The lognormal scenarios are synthetic stress tests, not measurements of any deployed system.
The examples establish estimand separation, not bias of either correctly targeted estimator for its own estimand.
Predictable planned-size weighting remains subject to the existing w_i <= 1 cap/normalization and current-outcome predictability contract.
